name: Aaron Schock
summary:
Aaron Jon Schock (born May 28, 1981) is a former American politician who was the U.S. representative for Illinois's 18th congressional district from 2009 until 2015. A member of the Republican Party, Schock represented the 92nd District of the Illinois House of Representatives from 2005 to 2009.
Schock resigned from Congress in March 2015 amid a scandal involving his use of public and campaign funds.
